entities.summary: Reni Folawiyo is a Nigerian lawyer turned fashion entrepreneur, business woman and founder of Alara, West Africa’s first fashion luxury and lifestyle concept store which was designed by British-Ghanaian architect David Adjaye. She owns NOK and NOK Garden by Alara to promote African cuisine.
